description: This file defines a tool for adding a chart to an existing dashboard in Apache Superset, including layout management and dashboard update logic.

methods.name: _find_next_row_position
methods.description: Finds the next available row index in the dashboard layout.

methods.name: _add_chart_to_layout
methods.description: Adds a chart and its row to the dashboard layout structure.

methods.name: _ensure_layout_structure
methods.description: Ensures the layout has proper GRID and ROOT structure, adding them if necessary.

methods.name: add_chart_to_existing_dashboard
methods.description: Main function to add a chart to an existing dashboard with automatic layout positioning.
